body:
Some time ago I have went with my friend, who I will refer to as H, to a smartshop in my town to see what sort of stuff is sold there, and if there were any legal highs we could buy. I only smoked weed before and tried half a blotter of 25C-NBOMe which was merely a pretty weak euphoric feeling, so I had no idea what this was going to be like.
We bought 2 small packs of something called 'Rainbow', the ingredients noting 'althea officinalis' and nothing else. I figured it should be a weak visual high, as I heard from another person that tried it. He said the only thing it does is make you see colors everywhere. This was definitely not the case here.
I saw no reports or info of this [online], and only some information on the internet that said it doesn't give any effects when smoked. Still, we rolled up about half a pack, one pack contained 0.7 g, with some tobacco in a joint. We figured we would need to roll another one later so I got everything ready.
Since I rolled, H said that I should take the first hit. I light it up and take two short inhalations before passing it to H. The taste of it was nearly exactly like cannabis, except something was strange here. I told H that maybe they gave us cannabis instead and laughed. He took maybe 1 long hit and then said he couldn't anymore. This surprised me a bit so I kept smoking. Bad idea.
I look at him and he says 'man, I'm getting some really strange buzz' and I completely knew what he meant. We had Shpongle - Around the World in a Tea Daze playing quietly through my speakers at the time.
After a while it all got really, extremely intense. I had to turn off the music since it was making me absolutely lose connection of reality, and that is NOT what I wanted. It didn't help at all. Afterwards, for I don't know how long I was just sitting at the chair, no colors, no visuals, no patterns, just lost and entirely disconnected.
I was just sitting at the chair, no colors, no visuals, no patterns, just lost and entirely disconnected.
Unaware of where my real body was. Unaware of what was a body. I completely forgot about the real world, and started thinking I was somebody else. For some time I have felt as if I got back to my senses again, but then I thought 'no way this is reality, I need to find the real reality'.
This went on until H collapsed off his chair, lying on the floor for a while and I say 'did you just fall off your chair?!' and start laughing uncontrollably. He gets up and seems pretty sick. I knew he was there and I knew what his name was, but that was pretty much it. He went to lie down on my bed, still both of us entirely disconnected, until I heard some unusual noise. I looked at him and he's vomitting on the bed and over himself. This really shocked me, because I was unsure of how much time passed, where I was or what was going on. I asked him if he was alright but he didn't say anything and kept on vomiting. Suddenly I got a short lasting rush of reality, I thought someone was going to find us and that they were going to see the mess on the bed. I was also unable to focus on anything, and that didn't help. I was shaking uncontrollably and I told H 'what are we going to do now?!'
This kept on and I was really freaked out, still trying to regain consciousness. I walked around the room without a clue and he was still vomiting there. I looked at him and it made me sick. I didn't feel the need to vomit though as I haven't eaten anything in about 3 hours, but he had before drank soda and ate chocolate.
So this went on for a while, until I couldn't handle it anymore. I called a relative of his to pick him up and I figured it would be best to blame it on the food as he has gastritis.
That worked out well and I cleaned up the mess we had made, but I still felt this dissociative feeling for over 10 hours after taking that. He went to sleep sooner than me, but I was way too shocked from the experience to do that.
I remember telling myself and him these words 'never again'. He knew exactly what I meant.
I'm definitely not going to do anything else other than weed in a long while. And if anyone ever gets this sort of stuff, I would recommend not taking it.
